scenario_selection: all 24 specified combinations; no event truth used for fitting or selection

fit.residual_first_step: zero-mean stationary AR(1) state with variance sigma^2/(1-phi^2)
fit.residual_innovation: N(0, sigma^2), including the first innovation
fit.coefficient_resampling: 5-year block bootstrap with replacement; 1000 draws, seed fixed

melt_interval.interval_semantics: 2.5% and 97.5% quantiles of one uniformly sampled event time within each paired half-open hourly support; conditional on finite members. The complete finite-member support envelope [min(L),max(U)] and the separately trimmed endpoint-quantile envelope are reported without being substituted for the event-time interval. The convex support envelope may contain gaps and is not the exact union of member supports.
